settings.ekit_heading_title: Nil T2 Filing in Brampton, Including Years You Have Missed
settings.ekit_heading_extra_title:
Most people who come to us from Brampton are not one year behind. They are three, or five, or more. A corporation was set up, it did little or nothing, and the filing quietly stopped being thought about. Nothing in that chain cancels the returns. Each of those years is still owed, and each stays on the CRA account until it is filed.

Catching up is less work than it sounds. Send the corporation number, the year end and the list of years outstanding. We confirm which of them were genuinely nil, prepare each return, send a T183CORP for each year to sign, and transmit them oldest first so the account clears in order. From Bramalea to Mount Pleasant, it is the same process and none of it needs a visit.

settings.title: Bring your Brampton filings up to date
Catching Up in Brampton: What People Ask

settings.html:
How many years can I leave before it becomes a problem?

There is no point at which an unfiled year is written off. It stays open on the CRA account until its return is transmitted, however long that takes. Unfiled returns.

Do the years have to be filed in order?

Oldest first. Each year is its own return, and filing them in sequence is what lets the account reconcile cleanly rather than leaving gaps. Catch-up filing.

What does it cost for several years at once?

$300.00 plus HST per tax year, with no discount and no surcharge for volume. Five outstanding years is five returns at that figure. What the fee covers.

What do you need from me to begin?

The corporation number, the fiscal year end, and which years are outstanding. That is enough to start; we come back if anything else is needed.

How do I know the year qualifies as nil?

Nothing in, nothing out, nobody paid, no movement in the bank account. Where that is not the case we say so before charging. What no activity means.

Is a signature needed for every year separately?

Yes. A T183CORP authorises one tax year, so five years means five forms, each signed on screen. How signing works.

Does catching up on the T2 also catch up my Ontario annual return?

No. The Ontario annual return is a separate filing through the Ontario Business Registry and is not part of this. We check whether yours is behind and tell you. Check your date.

One of those years the company earned a little. What then?

That year is not nil and is priced separately; the surrounding nil years still are. We separate them before anything is charged. When a year is not nil.

Can this be done if I am not in Canada?

Yes. Everything including the signature is electronic, so where a director lives makes no difference. Non-resident owned corporations.

Once I am caught up, does it stop?

No. A return is due for every year the corporation exists. Only dissolution ends it, and that needs a final return of its own. Final T2 before dissolution.
